titel: Will your model fit your printer? Check it first 📏 #blender #3dprinting
printzin: Every printer is different: print a small test first.

scenes.tekst: Is your model too big for your printer?
scenes.label: QUICK CHECK

scenes.tekst: Check it in Blender, before you slice.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: First, in Scene properties, set Unit Scale to 0.001 and Length to millimeters.
scenes.label: STEP 1
scenes.uitspraak: First, in Scene properties, set Unit Scale to zero point zero zero one, and Length to millimeters.

scenes.tekst: Press N. Under Dimensions you see the real size: 310 mm tall.
scenes.label: STEP 2
scenes.uitspraak: Press N. Under Dimensions you see the real size: three hundred ten millimeters tall.

scenes.tekst: This box is a print bed of 220 by 220 by 250 mm. The pawn is too tall for it.
scenes.label: TOO TALL
scenes.uitspraak: This box is a print bed of two hundred twenty by two hundred twenty by two hundred fifty millimeters. The pawn is too tall for it.

scenes.tekst: Hover over the view, press S, type 0.7 and press Enter.
scenes.label: STEP 3
scenes.uitspraak: Hover over the view, press S, type zero point seven, and press Enter.

scenes.tekst: Now it is 217 mm tall, and it fits inside the bed.
scenes.label: IT FITS
scenes.uitspraak: Now it is two hundred seventeen millimeters tall, and it fits inside the bed.

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different, so print a small test first. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
scenes.uitspraak: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
